params.name: pr
params.description: Pull request number to resolve feedback on

routines.description: Fetch unresolved PR review comments via GitHub API

steps.command: gh pr view {{pr}} --repo {{owner}}/{{repo}} --json number,title,headRefName,state,headRepository --jq '{number, title, headRefName, state, owner: (.headRepository.nameWithOwner | split("/")[0]), repo: (.headRepository.nameWithOwner | split("/")[1])}'

gh api graphql -f query='query($owner:String!,$repo:String!,$pr:Int!){repository(owner:$owner,name:$repo){pullRequest(number:$pr){reviewThreads(first:100){nodes{id,isResolved,comments(first:50){nodes{id,body,path,diffHunk}}}}}}}' -F owner={{owner}} -F repo={{repo}} -F pr={{pr}}

routines.description: Apply a group of feedback items via the implement pipeline
Post reply and resolve a review thread

steps.command:
cat > /tmp/ff-reply-$$.md << 'FFEOF'
{{reply}}
FFEOF
gh api graphql -f query='mutation($threadId:ID!,$body:String!){addPullRequestReviewThreadReply(input:{pullRequestReviewThreadId:$threadId,body:$body}){comment{id}}}' -F threadId={{threadId}} -F body=@/tmp/ff-reply-$$.md; status=$?; rm -f /tmp/ff-reply-$$.md; exit $status

case "{{verdict}}" in fixed|fixed-differently|not-addressing) gh api graphql -f query='mutation($threadId:ID!){resolveReviewThread(input:{threadId:$threadId}){thread{id}}}' -F threadId={{threadId}} ;; esac
